soundness_flags.label: ass:innovation-atomicity
soundness_flags.one_line: The sole new load-bearing condition is illustrated by one analytic density family but has no credible real-world applicability, genericity, or diagnostically testable sufficient condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:innovation-atomicity and def:admissible-class
soundness_flags.one_line: “Nondegenerate smooth positive residual innovation” is undefined, so innovation atomicity does not specify the residual class being universally excluded.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1454--1456, Definitions 2--3, Condition 1, Theorem 2.1, and Corollary 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Definition 2 defines a GANM on an acyclic supplied group graph with mutually independent block noises and positive noise densities; Corollary 1 identifies that supplied graph under its parent--node--nondescendant Condition 1 requirement.
Condition 19 is the scalar differential non-reversibility condition; Definition 27 imposes it on conditional parent--node triples; Theorem 28 identifies a causally minimal restricted-ANM DAG.
A reverse scalar additive-noise representation forces the stated log-density differential equation, supplying the scalar obstruction used only as an analogue in the proposal.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Causal Inference 12 (2024) published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that it works under a fixed partition and calls learning a partition--graph pair under optimality constraints an interesting but challenging future problem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the informal atomicity condition with a fully quantified residual class (for example, positive log-C3 densities and C3 maps), then prove a checkable sufficient criterion and an open family of atomic vector innovations rather than only one density family.

Add a domain-grounded justification for atomicity: identify a multichannel measurement setting in which internal directional ANM decompositions are substantively implausible, and state observable diagnostics that can falsify the condition.

After resolving the two rigidity obligations, add a finite-dimensional decision procedure or a constructive partition-search reduction; this would make the new identified target operational and strengthen the result beyond a population uniqueness theorem.

recommended_next_step: Revise the atomicity assumption into a precise, practically motivated model class before advancing the otherwise novel unknown-partition identification kernel.
